reviewer: Codex integrator, separate from drafting agent
scope: Read all eight narratives covering ten records and their identity notes; seven focused source checks. Not comprehensive historical or geometric certification.

findings.issue: The first Arabic word had silently normalized the ministry transcription, and the locator incorrectly said that word was outside the excerpt.
findings.resolution: Shorten to the exact phrase beginning اختلاف; revise the translation and locator accordingly.

findings.issue: A sentence tied adoption of Marxism to the 1975 name change without distinguishing the earlier ideological declaration.
findings.resolution: Remove the unsupported date association and retain the verified 1975 renaming and 1990 transition.
